localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters (approximate diameter 2-10 pixels) concentrated at the distal terminal tip and on the peaks of leading-edge protrusions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense white pixel clustering on the distal extremity and along the leading-edge tubercles indicating calcified attachments or persistent scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: The subject is a pectoral fin rather than a fluke; displays prominent rounded leading-edge tubercles and a long, narrow geometric profile with heavy white pigmentation/scarring at the distal point.
